## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change belongs in LidMode's focused scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Shell syntax and property-list checks pass.
- [ ] Swift formatting passes.
- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Release build passes.
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate tests or a documented hardware acceptance result.
- [ ] Normal sleep was restored after any privileged or hardware test.

## Security and scope

- [ ] The privilege boundary and exact helper allowlist are not broadened, or the security impact is explicitly justified.
- [ ] No credential, signing material, personal file, telemetry, analytics, or unnecessary network behavior is included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where user behavior or limitations changed.
